units.source_text: 在芝红叶馆举行的开局仪式上，黑子白子都只下了一手，第二天也只进行到十二手。

en.t: At the opening ceremony held at the Shiba Koyokan, Black and White each played only one move, and even on the second day the game advanced only to the twelfth move.

units.source_text: 然后决定将对局场地转移到箱根去。

en.t: It was then decided to move the venue of the match to Hakone.

units.source_text: 名人、大竹七段，还有工作人员一起出发，抵达堂岛对星馆的当天，没有继续对弈，对弈者之间也没发生龃龉。

en.t: The Master, Otake 7-dan, and the staff set out together, and on the day they arrived at Dojima Taiseikan, play did not resume and no friction arose between the players.

units.source_text: 傍晚时分，名人还喝了将近一瓶酒，心情十分舒畅，甚至谈笑风生。

en.t: Toward evening, the Master even drank nearly a whole bottle of sake, felt very cheerful, and talked and laughed with ease.
